queries_used.note: Two parallel research passes (media; storage and entity graph) plus lead spot checks. Wall-clock about 14 minutes for the passes. Browser support read from @mdn/browser-compat-data 8.1.9 locally; livekit-client facts read from the installed 2.24.1 package.

candidates.name: livekit-client

evidence.claim: 2.24.1 dist/src/room/video/extension.d.ts: setScreenShareEnabled(enabled, options?, publishOptions?); remote sources ScreenShare and ScreenShareAudio.
sendText(text, {topic, destinationIdentities}); destinationIdentities empty means all participants; registerTextStreamHandler(topic, handler).
2.24.1 room/chat/extension.d.ts: sendChatMessage is @deprecated in favour of sendText.

2.24.1 Room: static getLocalDevices(kind, requestPermissions), switchActiveDevice(kind, deviceId, exact) throws for audiooutput without setSinkId; canPlaybackAudio, startAudio(), RoomEvent.AudioPlaybackStatusChanged.

candidates.decision_rationale: Every needed realtime API exists in the pinned version; the gap is our port, adapter and UI.
risks: Private chat is routed by the server but not encrypted.
Audio output selection unavailable on Android browsers; must be gated.

candidates.name: @livekit/track-processors

evidence.claim: npm view: 0.8.3, Apache-2.0, modified 2026-11-12; peer livekit-client ^1.12.0 || ^2.1.0; depends on @mediapipe/tasks-vision 0.10.14.

0.8.3 dist/index.mjs:1137-1141: default WASM from cdn.jsdelivr.net tasks-vision 0.10.14 and model from storage.googleapis.com selfie_segmenter latest; assetPaths {tasksVisionFileSet, modelAssetPath} overrides both.
BackgroundProcessor({mode}) with switchTo(); BackgroundBlur and VirtualBackground deprecated; supportsBackgroundProcessors() requires OffscreenCanvas, VideoFrame, createImageBitmap, WebGL2.

candidates.decision_rationale: Official LiveKit processor for blur and image backgrounds; only works under our CSP if its assets are self-hosted.
risks: Needs script-src 'wasm-unsafe-eval' and ideally worker-src blob:.
About 9.6 MB of WASM to self-host and lazy-load.
Fast path Chromium-only; Safari and Firefox use a slower canvas fallback (versions inferred, not tested).

candidates.name: @mediapipe/tasks-vision

evidence.claim: tasks-vision 0.10.14 wasm/: vision_wasm_internal.wasm 9.4 MB plus 210 KB loader, and a no-SIMD pair; loader injected as a script element.

candidates.decision_rationale: Transitive dependency of C-02; its wasm folder and a pinned selfie_segmenter model are copied to our origin at build time.
risks: Upstream model URL is an unpinned 'latest'; we pin our own copy.

candidates.name: @electric-sql/pglite

evidence.claim: npm view: 0.5.16, Apache-2.0.
pglite docs/docs/filesystems.md: idb:// works in Chrome, Safari, Firefox on the main thread; opfs-ahp:// worker-only and broken on Safari (252 handle limit).
pglite docs/docs/multi-tab-worker.md: PGliteWorker with leader election shares one instance across tabs.
0.5.16 tarball: pglite.wasm 3.24 MB, pglite.data 1.85 MB, initdb.wasm 0.13 MB gzipped; assets loaded via new URL(..., import.meta.url).

candidates.decision_rationale: The local store named by the operator and by pem-local-first; works in all target browsers on idb://.
risks: About 5.2 MB gzipped; lazy-load after first paint.
Data is lost if the user clears site data.

candidates.name: pem-local-first pattern (hybrid-mobile-architecture)

evidence.claim: SKILL.md:25-80: transports read the local store and honour ListQuery; persistence adapter and startLocalFirstGraph wired once; Zustand transient only; no TanStack Query.
entity-graph-core src/adapters/pglite-persistence.ts:142-171 at 84d010b: createPGlitePersistenceAdapter stores the graph as JSON rows in _graph_snapshot, rewritten on debounced change.

candidates.decision_rationale: Follow the layering and transport rules; keep Know Meet's own history tables as the source and skip the snapshot adapter for history to avoid a second growing copy.
risks: Deviation from the skill recipe must be recorded in the spec.
Skill assumes tenant_id and a sync queue; local-only uses a per-device id and no queue.

candidates.name: Mediabunny

evidence.claim: npm view: 1.66.0, MPL-2.0; successor to deprecated mp4-muxer and webm-muxer.

candidates.decision_rationale: Only needed if we later encode with WebCodecs and mux ourselves; MediaRecorder is enough for this phase.
risks: MPL-2.0 file-level copyleft if adopted later.

candidates.name: LiveKit documentation on client-side recording

evidence.claim: Search found only Egress docs; no official guidance for recording in the browser.

candidates.decision_rationale: Confirms the recorder is ours to build and support.

candidates.name: OPFS + navigator.storage (platform)

evidence.claim: @mdn/browser-compat-data 8.1.9: createWritable Chrome 86, Firefox 111, Safari 26; createSyncAccessHandle Safari 15.2+ worker-only; storage.persist Chrome 55, Firefox 57, Safari 15.2.
Quotas: Chrome 60% of disk; Firefox min(10% disk, 10 GiB) or 50% when persisted; Safari 17+ about 60%; QuotaExceededError on overflow.

candidates.decision_rationale: Stream recording chunks to OPFS from a same-origin worker so memory stays flat and Safari 15.2+ is covered.
risks: Eviction without persist(); quota failure mid-recording must stop cleanly.

candidates.name: MediaRecorder + canvas.captureStream + AudioContext (platform)

evidence.claim: BCD 8.1.9: MediaRecorder Chrome 47, Firefox 25, Safari 14.1; canvas.captureStream Chrome 51, Firefox 43, Safari 11; createMediaStreamDestination universal.
Chrome M126 records MP4 (avc1/mp4a) in MediaRecorder.

candidates.decision_rationale: Platform primitives for the composite recorder we build.
risks: Firefox records WebM only; choose the container at runtime with isTypeSupported.
CPU cost of compositing on low-end devices.

candidates.name: RecordRTC

evidence.claim: npm view: 5.6.2, MIT; a MediaRecorder wrapper without multi-participant compositing.

candidates.decision_rationale: Adds a dependency for what MediaRecorder already does; does not composite.

candidates.decision_rationale: Rejected by operator instruction (from main, pinned commit, built from source). Recorded because a 5.0.1 release would remove the submodule and pre-install build.
